question: Which of the following diseases is NOT caused by ingesting polluted water?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabies **____**disease is NOT caused by ingesting polluted water**__.

 __
 
• Rabies is caused by the **rabies virus**.
 
• Infected animals have the virus in their saliva.
 
• The virus enters the body through broken skin or the eyes, nose, or mouth, and travels through nerves to the brain.
 
• People used to call** rabies hydrophobia** because it appears to cause a fear of water.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meningitis**, Typhoid, and Cholera are caused due to polluted water.

 
 
• Meningitis is an inflammation (swelling) of the protective membranes covering the brain and spinal cord.
 
 
 
• **Typhoid** fever is a life-threatening illness caused by **Salmonella Typhi bacteria**.
 
 
• Paratyphoid fever is a life-threatening illness caused by Salmonella Paratyphi bacteria.
 
 
 
• **Cholera** is an acute diarrheal illness caused by infection of the intestine with** Vibrio cholerae bacteria**.
 
 
• People can get sick when they swallow food or water contaminated with cholera bacteria. The infection is often mild or without symptoms, but can sometimes be severe and life-threatening.
